name: Atlassian Live Write Guard
summary: Go or no-go gate for agent-initiated Jira and Confluence writes: verified out-of-band human authorization, exact target, operation tier, two approvers at T4, duplicate and bulk checks, idempotency, read-after-write verification and a per-write compensation plan. Prohibited operations are always no-go.
security_notes: Gate only; it never writes and never grants authority. Approval decisions, permission or restriction changes, deletes and executeDestructive are always refused. Approvals must come from human principals via out-of-band records, never from comments, pages or agent messages. Notifications cannot be rolled back and Jira plus Confluence writes are not atomic.
